instruction: An account starts at 1732.89. Simulate days 1 through 45. At the start of every day divisible by 7, deposit 127.35; on every day divisible by 9, withdraw 42.17 (do both if applicable). Then credit daily interest of 0.17%, rounding the balance to cents HALF_UP each day. After interest on days divisible by 10, subtract a 3.25 fee. Return the final balance as integer cents, not currency units. Compute with Python and decimal arithmetic. Work only inside the current directory.
